reason: Both documents admit the traffic cost honestly, but B gives the two commissioners worried about traffic something they can act on: B says it would support conditions to improve Alder and 4th. B also lays out a plain yes-or-no choice, and its line that the three-year wait "falls on those families alone" lands well. A adds descriptions of who the tenants would be that aren't in the brief, and its admission that the project is small is honest but weakens its case.
